changes: Takes less of the RAM all modules share, so more modules fit beside it. No change to how it works or sounds.
The FX track's DELAY HPF and LPF and REVERB FRQ, HPF and LPF now show their frequency in Hz and kHz, like FILTER FRQ.
LPF follows HPF, as the stock filters do, and reads OPEN where the low-pass lets everything through (the defaults included).
Locked values on these knobs get the same wide white box, so kHz values fit.
Fixes a locked FRQ above 1 kHz spilling out of its white lock box: FRQ's box is now wider, the same size for every value.
The unlocked display and every other parameter's lock box look as before.
First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on core-ar2 0.3. The FILTER page's FRQ popup shows the cutoff in hertz, from 13.8Hz to 21.1kHz, instead of 0 to 127.
Documentation note: shortened the release notes to keep catalogue validation working; hardware and package verification details are recorded in PR #831.
